name: Origin Factory Store
old_description: Got 2 of these Core Polos today! Black and battleship in size medium! They have a nice feel similar to Ogio golf polos. The fit is what’s to be expected out of a nice polo, true to size but slightly more fitted. I have more medium-sized Origin Core t-shirts than I can count and they definitely fit much looser than the Core polo. This is fine for me because I don’t like tucking in a super loose shirt and having muffin top going on. I recommend these because they’re both aesthetically pleasing and comfortable. Been buying Origin gear since 2020 and not a regret with this Core polo.
about:
Origin Factory Store, operating under the ORIGIN® brand, is headquartered in Farmington, Maine. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources. The business presents itself as an American-made apparel, footwear, and gear brand with a focus on domestic manufacturing.

ORIGIN produces a range of soft goods and footwear including performance denim, stretch canvas work pants, sneakers, fleece hoodies, performance polos, waffle-knit layers, and training apparel. Key product lines feature proprietary fabrics such as MOAB™ stretch canvas, NanoRip stretch-woven ripstop, and CORE Waffle knit (69% polyester/31% cotton). The company states that its joggers are manufactured in North Carolina and that its sneakers are assembled from a 100% U.S. supply chain—including Vibram® outsoles and MOAB™ uppers—by skilled American craftsmen. Manufacturing processes encompass cut-and-sew assembly, knitwear production, ripstop weaving, felled-seam construction, gusseted patterning, double-needle topstitching, and military-spec hardware installation.

The brand serves consumer markets directly through its e-commerce channel, targeting outdoor, tactical, training, and Brazilian jiu-jitsu (BJJ) enthusiasts. No business-to-business customers or industrial end markets are identified in the source material.

ORIGIN positions its domestic supply chain as a differentiator, framing the re-establishment of American sneaker and apparel manufacturing as a new standard for quality and durability. The company emphasizes overbuilt construction, odor-control technologies such as HeiQ Fresh, and durable water-repellent finishes to extend product life across work, training, and daily wear.
